title: grantcheck report, schema version 1.0
description: The output of `grantcheck --format json` and of the hosted /api/check/{ein} endpoint. Within major version 1, changes are additive only: keys may be added, never renamed, removed, or redefined. An unknown value is null and never an empty string, because an empty string reads as 'we looked and found nothing', which is a different claim from 'we did not look'.

schema_version.description: Major.minor. Consumers should pin the major version.

ein.description: Formatted with the hyphen. This is the canonical display form.

queried_at.description: When this report was produced, UTC, ISO 8601.

readiness.description: 'blocked' means a mechanical hard stop was observed, not that we judged the organization ineligible. An 'unknown' check never produces 'blocked'.

blocking_check_ids.description: Ids of checks that failed and are blocking, in registry order.

disclosure.description: Required verbatim text. Present in every report in every format.

notes.description: Caveats about how this report was produced, such as an inferred SAM.gov match or a stale cached index.

organization.description: Identity as the IRS has it, or null when the EIN is not in the index.

ruling_date.description: YYYY-MM. The Business Master File carries month precision only; a full date here would invent a day the source never claimed.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier. Part of the public contract; renaming one is a breaking change.

status.description: 'not_applicable' means the check does not apply to this organization, which is different from 'unknown', meaning we could not determine it.

blocking.description: Whether a 'fail' here mechanically prevents submission. True on a non-failing check simply describes the check's nature.

confidence.description: Present only where a fact was inferred rather than looked up.

vintages.description: Every dataset this report drew on, with the date its source declares.

opportunities.description: Null unless OpenGrants enrichment ran. An empty array means it ran and matched nothing.

vintage.description: When the SOURCE says its data was published, not when we downloaded it.
